firm_data.firm_description: Kaufmann Gildin & Robbins is a boutique law firm in the heart of New York City, known for its expertise in franchising, litigation, and corporate matters. The firm provides legal support to individuals as well as some of the world’s largest corporations.
notable_facts: Ranked Tier 1 – Nationwide by Best Lawyers in America in Franchising.
Represented YUM! Brands, Inc., Wendys’ International, Inc., 7-Eleven Inc., Marriott International, Inc., among others.
David J. Kaufmann authored the New York Franchise Act.

email.subject: AI for Kaufmann Gildin & Robbins, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Daniel,

Your firm's Tier 1 ranking in Franchising from Best Lawyers in America speaks to the caliber of work you deliver. That same precision is what we're building into Lucio, an AI platform designed for boutique firms balancing sophisticated client demands with lean operations.

We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency. We've completed successful pilots on the East Coast and are now expanding into new markets.

I'd welcome 20 minutes to show you how our ex-lawyer team is helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw on the work that matters most.

Worth a brief conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
